chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said: “There is no intercessor more successful than tawbah (repentance).”

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام
key_terms.أَنْجَحُ: more successful, more effective in attaining the desired outcome
key_terms.التَّوْبَةِ: repentance; returning sincerely to Allah after sin
key_terms.شَفِيعَ: an intercessor; that which mediates for acceptance or deliverance

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali عليه السلام say about the power of repentance?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام teaches that tawbah (repentance) is the most effective means by which a person seeks deliverance and divine mercy. The hadith highlights the spiritual power of returning to Allah sincerely and its role in salvation.
